title: Why Doctor Doom Put On a Red-Hot Mask
description: Victor von Doom wanted to hide the scar left by his lab accident. In Marvel’s Books of Doom, his search takes him to a mountain forge and to a decision that makes his injuries worse. A short comic-lore retelling with original geometric illustrations.
rows: Doom's mask was still red-hot. He wanted it on his face anyway. This is Books of Doom.
It started in a college lab. His machine blew up and left him with a scar he wanted to hide.
Victor went to Tibet, where an order of monks helped him forge a suit of armor.
They worked the glowing metal on an anvil. The last piece was the one Victor cared about most.
He could have waited for the mask to cool. He wanted it on now.
THERE WAS STILL TIME TO WAIT
He put it on while the metal was still hot. The mask meant to hide his scar burned him again.
HE WORE IT BEFORE IT COOLED
The glow faded. The damage stayed.
That's how the thing Victor made to hide his face became the face of Doctor Doom. Follow for more comic lore.
